pages.text: $(italic)Scion of a forgotten god. Towers over mortal limits with massive health and divine abilities.$()$(br2)$(bold)Divine Body$(): $(item)+8 max health$() (four extra hearts), the tankiest race.$(br2)$(bold)Divine Swiftness$(): Speed II at all times outside the Nether.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Divine Fury$(): gain Strength on command, on a 50s cooldown.$(br2)$(bold)Phase$(): pass through blocks for a moment.$(br2)$(bold)Divine Appetite$(): raw meat and fish feed you twice as much; cooked food feeds you as usual.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Cursed$(): $(warn)fire burns you 50% hotter and the Nether gives you Weakness$(), but you can fight through it.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with a glass-cannon class. The four extra hearts buy back what Archmage or Void Summoner gives up: only gear health is halved.$()
